from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys,shutil
ROOT=Path('${CBUS_REPOSITORY_ROOT}');OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
TARGET=Path('${CBUS_CARGO_TARGET}')
FILES=['rust/cbus-cgate/src/service.rs','rust/cbus-cgate/src/service/tests.rs','docs/cmqttd-cgate.md','rust/cmqttd/tests/system_cgate_programmer_lifecycle.rs']
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
before={p:sha(ROOT/p) for p in FILES}
old=OUT/'pre-correction-bin';old.mkdir(mode=0o700)
for n in ('cgate-mock','cmqttd'):shutil.copy2(TARGET/'release'/n,old/n)
env=os.environ.copy();env.update(CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(TARGET),CARGO_BUILD_JOBS='2')
commands=[('fmt',['cargo','+1.92.0','fmt','--all','--check']),('clippy',['cargo','+1.98.1','clippy','--workspace','--all-targets','--','-D','warnings']),('release',['cargo','+1.92.0','build','--release','--workspace'])]
record={'sources_before':before,'pre_correction_binaries':{n:sha(old/n) for n in ('cgate-mock','cmqttd')},'commands':[],'full_test_suite_run':False}
for label,argv in commands:
 log=OUT/('rust-'+label+'.log')
 with log.open('w') as f:r=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=ROOT/'rust',env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 record['commands'].append({'name':label,'argv':argv,'exit':r.returncode,'log_sha256':sha(log)})
 (OUT/'rust-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');print(label,r.returncode,flush=True)
 if r.returncode:sys.exit(r.returncode)
record['sources_after']={p:sha(ROOT/p) for p in FILES};assert before==record['sources_after']
record['sources_stable']=True;record['release_binaries']={n:sha(TARGET/'release'/n) for n in ('cgate-mock','cmqttd')}
(OUT/'rust-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(record['release_binaries']),flush=True)
